node.title: Re: Finding unique elements in inputs
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
grep {$_ ne $elemnt} @value

In this context, this means "count how many elements in @values don't equal $element". When @values is initially empty, this will always be zero and therefore false. See the [id://745674], adding [doc://print]s of things like @values and the condition in the loop will be helpful, especially with [doc://Data::Dumper]. I suspect you meant not grep {$_ eq $elemnt} @values instead, however, this will be inefficient for larger arrays, and as [GrandFather] already [id://11151808|said], the typical solution is to use a hash. See also [doc://perlfaq4#How-can-I-remove-duplicate-elements-from-a-list-or-array?]
